## Safety Checklist

- [ ] I ran `bash scripts/audit-public.sh`.
- [ ] I did not add secrets, private paths, browser profiles, cookies, VPN state, SSH keys, tokens, private hostnames, or work/client configuration.
- [ ] Any new third-party repo, extension, package source, or external installer is opt-in and clearly explained.
- [ ] Any bundled third-party asset has credits and license/source metadata in `CREDITS.md`.
- [ ] Existing user config is backed up or skipped before modification.
- [ ] The change is reversible or documented in `revert.sh` / README.
